overclaims: Morris and colleagues proposed an AGI classification framework on June 5, 2024, but Marcus’s passage does not adopt it.
checks.note: Excerpt is verbatim. The proposition is faithful, though it drops 'current' before 'neural networks', which is minor. Axis not_applicable, open_horizon and not_adjudicable match the agreed reviews. Problem: the rationale says Morris et al. 'proposed' the framework on June 5, 2024. The evidence context shows it was first submitted on Nov 4, 2023; June 5, 2024 is only the v4 revision date. Rewrite it, e.g. 'a June 5, 2024 revision (v4) of Morris et al.'s framework, first posted Nov 2023'. Everything else is supported.
